newsitem.title: INDIA: India sets deadline for proposed power projects.
newsitem.headline: India sets deadline for proposed power projects.

text.p: India has asked private investors who have signed memorandums of understanding (MoUs) for power projects to submit a detailed project report by end-March, power secretary P. Abraham said on Friday.

"We have told them they should submit a detailed project report by March 31, 1997. Those that cannot submit are out on that day," Abraham, India's highest ranking civil servant in the Power Ministry, told Reuters in an interview.
Abraham said the deadline was aimed at identifying serious investors.
Nearly 250 private firms signed MoUs for power projects after the sector was opened in 1991 as part of the country's gradual conversion to a free-market economy.
"By March 1996, that number came down to around 95 when many who were not serious dropped out," Abraham said.
He said he would hold meetings with these investors in the next two months to discuss the status of their projects.
